scope: Independent paper/code/implementation crosswalk, not a numeric reproduction or protocol amendment

findings.paper_location: main PDF p3 / printed23140, Eq(1) and definition of L_cls
findings.paper_value: ordinary mean of per-example binary cross entropy
findings.code_value: sum of two label-mass-normalized class losses with probability clipping
findings.toolbox_value: balanced log-sigmoid loss; each class mass clamped to at least1; no entropy term

findings.paper_value: instance pairs plus (same cluster intersect same binary prediction) union local neighbors
findings.code_value: instance loss plus optional cluster/cutoff/neighbor terms; neighbor gate epoch>50
findings.toolbox_value: normalized hidden features; instance loss plus same-cluster term when groups supplied; no cutoff or neighbors
